about: Fischer Medical Ventures Ltd, earlier known as Fischer Chemic Ltd, leads a healthcare-technology group. It makes and services medical-imaging equipment and provides AI-based health screening and digital-health solutions. Its MRI manufacturing plant is located at Andhra Pradesh MedTech Zone (AMTZ), Visakhapatnam. [1]
